purpose: Untouched future cohort for the same event rule as V9-EVENTS-8K-ITEM202-RETRO 1.0.0 (docs/quant-recovery/v9/events/registration-retrospective-1.0.0.json). No event in this cohort had been accepted by SEC when this file was frozen; no outcome can exist yet.
rule: Identical to the retrospective registration: event category, availability clock (SEC acceptance, interpretation fixed by the header-parity sample), entry (first explicit XNYS session close strictly after acceptance), horizons 1/5/20 bars, costs 10+5 bps per side, SPY benchmark, controls (k=2, seed V9-EVENTS-CONTROL-1, +-10 session Item 2.02 exclusion), endpoints A_h and B_h, two-way cluster inference, Holm over 6, calendar-block bootstrap (blockLength 20, 9999 reps, seed 20261027), ENTRY_SESSION_GAP rule.

cohort.events: Original Form 8-K with Item 2.02 and acceptanceUtc strictly after 2026-10-27T18:25:00.000Z and <= 2027-03-31T23:59:59.999Z.
cohort.population: The listings retained by the retrospective run (results-retrospective-1.0.0.json, retainedListings and retainedDailySeriesHashesDigest; listing ids in event-ledger-1.0.0.json.gz exclusions complement), frozen at this registration; listings delisted, renamed (SEC formerNames 'to' within the cohort window) or whose ticker/CIK mapping changes before evaluation are reported as CENSORED_IDENTITY, never dropped silently or replaced. Membership evidence for the engine: validFrom 2026-10-27, availableAt = frozenAt.
cohort.gapNotEvaluated: Original Item 2.02 8-Ks accepted after the retrospective asOf (2026-10-26T23:59:59.999Z) and at/before this freeze are neither retrospective nor prospective; they are counted only.
cohort.acceptanceSource: Fresh SEC submissions JSON retrieved after the cohort window closes; header parity re-sampled on >=100 prospective filings before outcomes.

maturity.earliestEvaluation: After daily prices through 2027-04-29 are committed to quant/data/market/discover-series (expected 2027-04-30 or later). Earlier partial evaluation is prohibited; IMMATURE rows would be reported, not dropped.

confirmatoryCriterion: Primary confirmatory test: A1 (mean |AR_event| - mean |AR_control|, 1 bar) > 0 with Holm-adjusted two-way-cluster p < 0.05 within the 6-test family AND block-bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0. B_h are reported; no profitable-strategy claim is registered.
limitationsKnownInAdvance: Current-listing survivorship at freeze (population frozen, but its selection is conditional on survival to 2026-10-26).
SEC acceptance is an availability upper bound; company press release may be earlier.
Cohort spans essentially one to two earnings seasons; time clusters remain few.
